message.jaymospowers.fishing.missed: Too slow - it spat the hook.
message.jaymospowers.fishing.spooked: You're spooking the fish: too close to your hook, or splashing about. Stand back.
message.jaymospowers.fishing.line_ran_ou: It ran out all your line. The line parted at the reel.
hud.jaymospowers.fishing.title: %s  %s kg
hud.jaymospowers.fishing.hint: Hold Use to reel; ease off during runs, jumps and thrashing, and turn your rod against a run. Sneak + Use: let it go
hud.jaymospowers.fishing.hint.taking: It's taking the lure. Reel while it's calm; ease off when it runs, leaps or thrashes.
message.jaymospowers.fishing.hook_solid: Fish on - the hook's set solid!
message.jaymospowers.fishing.hook_light: Fish on - but only lightly hooked. Keep the line tight or it'll slip.
message.jaymospowers.fishing.hook_slippe: The line went slack and the hook slipped out.
message.jaymospowers.fishing.leap_snappe: You reeled through its leap. The line snapped.
message.jaymospowers.fishing.line_snagge: Your line snagged in the branches and broke.
